artifact_observations.reasoning: The flag lacks realistic fabric physics; it appears stiff and fused to the railing/superstructure rather than hanging or waving naturally. The folds look painted on.
The red cylindrical objects on the deck lack clear mechanical definition. They blend into each other and the deck, lacking distinct nozzles, valves, or mounting bases expected of fire monitors.
The rigging lines are faint and inconsistent in thickness. Some lines appear to terminate in mid-air or merge ambiguously with the mast structure.
The background exhibits a uniform, smudged blur typical of AI generation's difficulty with distant complex structures, lacking optical depth-of-field characteristics.
